column4: CODER_OAUTH2_GITHUB_ALLOWED_ORGS restricts new signups to members of listed GitHub orgs.
column6: Primary reference for env var names and behavior

column3: Coder Docs. GitHub OAuth — Custom App. https://coder.com/docs/admin/external-auth
column4: For production, Coder strongly recommends a custom GitHub OAuth App to avoid sharing org membership data with Coder the company.
The read:org scope allows reading private org membership without requiring users to publicize it.
Device flow (CODER_OAUTH2_GITHUB_DEVICE_FLOW=true) does not request read:org; enabling it alongside ALLOWED_ORGS causes 403 errors on org membership checks.
column6: Already documented in server-setup.md; must remain in runbook
